dialect.detail: Micro Focus COBOL with GnuCOBOL compatibility; uses $set directives (preprocess htmlpp, sourceformat free), COMP-5, COMP-X, CBL_CHECK_FILE_EXIST, CBL_RENAME_FILE runtime calls, external-form, identified by clauses, lock mode manual — all Micro Focus extensions. Brazilian Portuguese web application (mypub system).

purpose.domain_detail: Brazilian web application user management system (mypub); alters/manages user files including CPF/CNPJ, email, password, and admin records
purpose.summary: Program PWPA6100 manages user records for a Brazilian web publishing system (mypub). It handles reading, updating, and converting indexed user files, including email updates by CPF/CNPJ lookup and file renaming/backup operations. It appears to be a CGI-style web backend program processing HTML form input.

notable_features: COMP-5 and COMP-X usage (Micro Focus extensions)
CBL_CHECK_FILE_EXIST and CBL_RENAME_FILE runtime library calls
external-form and identified by clauses for CGI/HTML form input
lock mode is manual on indexed files
Multiple indexed files with composite keys and alternate keys
Brazilian Portuguese variable names and comments
verdict.notes: Source truncated at 16000 chars (587 total lines); procedure division partially visible. Program uses Micro Focus-specific extensions heavily. The 'online-cics' program_type is used loosely here — this is actually a CGI web program, not CICS, but no better enum value exists. Domain set to 'other' as it is a web user-management system not fitting standard categories cleanly. File uses latin-1 encoding with Portuguese text including accented characters.
